Cristiano Ronaldo gave everything to Portugal. Before his generation, Portugal had never won a major international trophy. With Ronaldo as captain, Portugal reached the top of Europe by winning UEFA Euro 2016 and later lifted the UEFA Nations League. He became Portugal's all-time leading goalscorer, captain, and greatest player, inspiring millions to believe that a small nation could compete with the world's best. Although the one trophy he dreamed of most—the FIFA World Cup—escaped him, his legacy was never defined by a single title.

For Neymar Jr., the dream was always to bring the World Cup back to Brazil. He dazzled the world with his skill, creativity, and joy, becoming one of the greatest players ever to wear the famous yellow shirt. Injuries, pressure, and heartbreak never stopped him from giving everything for his country. At the 2026 World Cup, Brazil's journey ended in the Round of 16, bringing Neymar's international career to a close without the World Cup he had chased his entire life.

World Cup 2026 was more than just another tournament. It was the final chapter for two football legends. The stadiums may grow quieter without them, but their goals, celebrations, unforgettable moments, and passion will live on forever.
